verdict.rationale: Fireflies exposes a documented GraphQL API with bearer-token authentication, an uploadAudio mutation, transcript/analytics queries, and webhook callbacks — all of which can be scripted and invoked non-interactively from a CI pipeline or automation server. However, there is no explicit CI/headless-mode documentation, official CLI, SDK, or example of running Fireflies in a CI pipeline; automation is only implied via generic API + webhook + Zapier integration docs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guide or example, official SDK/CLI for scripted headless use, and confirmation of rate-limit/service-account support for unattended batch jobs.
